_comment: A lone block of 96 Spearmen (6 files of 16) facing west, doubled to 12 files of 8 by a plain explicatio (B). Drill mode, no enemy. The new block is twice as wide and half as deep, so every old file splits into two new files, and off the centre both lie to one side of it. Split by depth, the rear half of a file walks forward past its front half walking back, one body apart. The expect at tick 50, just after the order, reads the deal itself: file_line_routes_crossing counts the men whose straight route to his new slot crosses that of another man of his own file line, and it is 0 when each file is interleaved into its two new files, neighbours side by side on one new rank. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
